problem_or_trigger: A parameter name is being used as a causal mechanism.
principle: Trace a parameter through the actual generator, compiler, force law and operation input before proposing its effect. Explicit inputs may override defaults.
assumptions: Check the frozen model, input binding and method admission.
applicability: Model-based tendon-robot research; cross-task transfer unverified.
diagnostic_questions: Is the operation using a fixed absolute input, a default input or reoptimized control?
Does the force law contain the claimed constitutive relation?
possible_actions: Read the candidate parameter execution_semantics and method admission.
Use a legal one-factor matched contrast only if the method can identify the proposed effect.
expected_observations: No compiled dynamics change at identical state/input weakens a proposed dynamics mechanism.
A changed default-input experiment cannot identify a fixed-input structural effect.
cannot_conclude: All actuator models share ideal-tension semantics
validation_status: Conditional method; no cross-task success guarantee.
